title: FYNE AUDIO、HDMI搭載のBluetoothスピーカー「Cubitt 5」
summary: アクシスは、FYNE AUDIOのアクティブスピーカー「Cubitt 5」を11月に発売する。外装フィニッシュはオリーブグリーン、ペブルグレー、パールチタン、ミッドナイトブラック、アークティックホワイトの5種類。価格はペア136,000円。

title: 【今月の自作PCレシピ】小さなミニタワーでかわいいゲーミングPCを組む
summary: 秋葉原の主要パーツショップ店員に聞いたオススメパーツ構成を紹介。コスト重視の激安から、最新ゲームをヌルヌル表示でプレイできるゲーミング構成まで、さまざまなPC構成をお届けしよう。

title: Casio's new keyboard listens to your music and corrects your notes as you play
summary: Casio's Casiotone CT-FS1 is a $399.99, 61-key keyboard based on the CT-S1 that uses a companion app and the bundled WU-BT10 Bluetooth adapter to shift a player's notes into harmony with a song in real time. It comes in all-black or all-white finishes.

title: Anker releases another version of new upgraded charger in UK
summary: The Anker Nano Charger (45W, Smart Display) is now available in a third colorway in the UK. This upgraded version of the charging accessory is also currently discounted at the brand’s online store.

title: Keychron Launches Steampunk Q19 HE 8K Gaming Keyboard
summary: Keychron's ongoing efforts to update its keyboard line-up with new models has produced the Q19 HE 8K as its latest special colorway of the 60% Hall effect PCB first introduced with the Q16 HE 8K and recently made another appearance in the Carbon 60 HE .
